headline: *Nifty falls* as broader market declines
subline: A risk-off day saw FIIs selling and VIX rising.
hero_text: The broader market followed Nifty's decline; FIIs sold Rs 6,121.37 Cr, DIIs bought Rs 4,596.57 Cr.

why.title: Market Slump
why.desc: No clear catalyst drove the decline.

why.title: Volatility Up
why.desc: India VIX rose, indicating increased risk.

sector_reasons.PSU Bank: PSU banks showed resilience with positive moves
sector_reasons.Media: Media sector was steady amid broader declines
sector_reasons.Private Bank: Private banks partially cushioned the fall
sector_reasons.Metal: Metals weighed heavily on the indices
sector_reasons.Auto: Auto sector hit by broad market negativity

bonus_text: While FIIs sold aggressively, DIIs provided support with significant buying.
movers_note_gainers: Kotak Bank and Bharti Airtel led the gainers.
movers_note_losers: Titan and Adani Enterprises fell sharply.
watch_text: Tomorrow, watch for FOMC Member Waller's speech at 18:00 IST.
lessons: Market breadth was weak with more declines than advances.
FIIs continued to sell, exerting pressure on the indices.
Volatility rose as India VIX climbed, reflecting market nervousness.
No specific catalyst was identified for the broad decline.
alert_text: FOMC Member Waller speaks at 18:00 IST tomorrow.
cta_sub: Full wrap every evening. Next bell is Thursday.
next_text: The next trading session is tomorrow, Thursday, 08 October 2026.
caption_a:
Nifty fell 0.76% to 22,603.05 amid a broader market decline.
FIIs net sold Rs 6,121.37 Cr while DIIs net bought Rs 4,596.57 Cr.
India VIX rose to 13.89, signaling increased volatility.
Watch: FOMC Member Waller's speech tomorrow at 18:00 IST.
